title: Fix TTL expiration and LRU eviction order in cache.py
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `ttl_cache/cache.py`:
1. When `capacity` is full and a new key is inserted, expired entries should be purged first before evicting the least-recently-used live entry.
2. Updating an existing key with `set(key, value)` must refresh its recency AND its expiration timestamp (using the injected `clock` function).
3. `get(key)` on an expired entry must delete it and return `None` without treating it as recently used.
Run existing tests with `pytest` and add/verify edge cases.
